latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: BMI & BSA Calculator for clinical and pediatric use.

- Calculates Body Mass Index (BMI) with weight classification based on adult/pediatric standards.
- Estimates Body Surface Area (BSA) using multiple formulas: DuBois, Mosteller, Haycock, Gehan-George, and Yu.
- Supports both adult and pediatric anthropometric assessment, including percentile and risk categorization.
- Provides utilities for chemotherapy and medication dosing by BSA, with sample clinical workflows.
- Accepts metric and imperial inputs, with detailed documentation and example usages.
